# Presentation

Preparación de datos para las bases correspondientes a 1999, 2009 and 2019 del [Social Inequality Module of International Social Survey Programme (ISSP)](https://www.gesis.org/en/issp/data-and-documentation/social-inequality).

```{r}
#| label: set
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, include = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

table_format <- if(is_html_output()) {
  "html"
} else if(is_latex_output()) {
  "latex"
}
table_format2 <- if(is_html_output()) {
  T
} else if(is_latex_output()) {
  F
}

options(kableExtra.html.bsTable = T)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```


## Libraries

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| include: true

if (! require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               car,
               sjmisc,
               here,
               sjlabelled,
               SciViews,
               naniar,
               haven,
               countrycode,
               ggrepel)


library(occupar)
options(scipen=999)
rm(list = ls())
```

## Data

```{r}
#| label: data
#| echo: true
#| output: false

issp99 <- read_dta(here("input/data/original/issp_1999.dta"))
issp09 <- read_dta(here("input/data/original/issp_2009.dta"))
issp19 <- read_dta(here("input/data/original/issp_2019.dta"))

```

# ISSP 1999

## Select

```{r}

db_proc99 <- issp99 %>% 
  select(year = v1, 
         v3,
         sex,
         age,
         educyrs,
         degree,
         rincome,
         rincomer,
         ess = v46,
         nmerit_wealthy_fam = v4,
         nmerit_contacts = v5,
         merit_effort = v6,
         merit_talent = v7,
         just_health = v39,
         just_educ = v40,
         perc_inequality = v57,
         isco88_4,
         selfemp,
         nemploy,
         wrksup,
         nwrksup,
         weight) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

```


##  Recode and transform

### Year

```{r}
frq(db_proc99$year)
db_proc99$year <- as.numeric(db_proc99$year)
frq(db_proc99$year)
```

### Country

```{r}
frq(db_proc99$v3)
db_proc99 <- db_proc99 %>% 
  mutate(country = case_when(
    v3 == 1  ~ "Australia",
    v3 == 2 | v3 == 3  ~ "Germany",
    v3 == 4  ~ "United Kingdom",
    v3 == 5  ~ "Ireland",
    v3 == 6  ~ "United States",
    v3 == 7  ~ "Austria",
    v3 == 8  ~ "Hungary",
    v3 == 10 ~ "Ireland",      
    v3 == 12 ~ "Norway",
    v3 == 13 ~ "Sweden",
    v3 == 14 ~ "Czechia",  
    v3 == 15 ~ "Slovenia",
    v3 == 16 ~ "Poland",
    v3 == 17 ~ "Bulgaria",
    v3 == 18 ~ "Russia",
    v3 == 19 ~ "New Zealand",
    v3 == 20 ~ "Canada",
    v3 == 21 ~ "Philippines",
    v3 == 22 ~ "Israel",
    v3 == 24 ~ "Japan",
    v3 == 25 ~ "Spain",
    v3 == 26 ~ "Latvia",
    v3 == 27 ~ "France",
    v3 == 28 ~ "Cyprus",
    v3 == 29 ~ "Portugal",
    v3 == 30 ~ "Chile",
    v3 == 33 ~ "Slovakia",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
db_proc99$iso_country <- countrycode::countrycode(db_proc99$country, origin = "country.name", destination = "iso3c")
frq(db_proc99$country); frq(db_proc99$iso_country)

```

### Sex
```{r}
frq(db_proc99$sex)
db_proc99$sex <- set_na(db_proc99$sex, na = c(9), drop.levels = F)
db_proc99 <- db_proc99 %>% 
mutate(sex = if_else(sex == 1, 'Male', 'Female'),
       sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")))
frq(db_proc99$sex)
```


### Age
```{r}
summary(db_proc99$age)
db_proc99$age <- set_na(db_proc99$age, na = c(98,99), drop.levels = F)
db_proc99$age <- as.numeric(db_proc99$age)

```

### Education
```{r}
# Eucation
frq(db_proc99$educyrs) # We don't know if this is equal in every country; we use degree
frq(db_proc99$degree)
db_proc99$degree <- set_na(db_proc99$degree, na = c(8,9), drop.levels = F)
db_proc99 <- db_proc99 %>% 
  mutate(educ = case_when(degree %in% c(1,2) ~ "Incomplete primary or less",
                            degree == 3 ~ "Complete primary",
                            degree == 4 ~ "Incomplete secondary",
                            degree == 5 ~ "Complete secondary",
                            degree == 6 ~ "Incomplete university",
                            degree == 7 ~ "Complete university",
                            TRUE ~ NA_character_),
           educ = factor(educ, 
                           levels = c("Incomplete primary or less",
                           "Complete primary",
                           "Incomplete secondary",
                           "Complete secondary",
                           "Incomplete university",
                           "Complete university")))

db_proc99 <- db_proc99 %>% 
  mutate(educ_dic = case_when(degree %in% c(1:6) ~ 'Less than universitary',
                              degree == 7 ~ 'Universitary',
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         educ_dic = factor(educ_dic, levels = c("Universitary", "Less than universitary")))
frq(db_proc99$educ)
frq(db_proc99$educ_dic)
```


### Income
```{r}

# Income continuous
summary(db_proc99$rincome)
db_proc99 <- db_proc99 %>%
  mutate(
    rincome = haven::zap_labels(rincome),
    rincome = sjmisc::set_na(rincome, na = c(999997,999998,999999))
  )

# ntile function without NAs
ntile_na <- function(x,n)
{
  notna <- !is.na(x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_,length(x))
  out[notna] <- ntile(x[notna],n)
  return(out)
}

db_proc99 %>% 
  mutate(decil = ntile_na(rincome, 10)) %>% 
  frq(decil)

# Income decil
frq(db_proc99$rincomer) 
db_proc99$rincomer <- set_na(db_proc99$rincomer, na = c(97,98,99), drop.levels = F) # there is a decil 0; those no income no labor force
db_proc99$income_decil <- as.numeric(db_proc99$rincomer)
frq(db_proc99$income_decil) 
```

```{r}
frq(db_proc99$ess)
```

### Class

```{r}

  mutate(
    selfemp_bin = if_else(selfemp == 1, 1, 0),
    nemploy_rec = case_when(
      nemploy == 9995 ~ 0,
      nemploy %in% c(9997, 9999) ~ NA_real_,
```

```{r}
db_proc99 <- db_proc99 %>% 
  select(year, country, iso_country, sex, age, educ, educ_dic, income_decil, ess, just_health, just_educ, perc_inequality, egp5,  merit_effort, merit_talent, nmerit_wealthy_fam, nmerit_contacts, weight)

save(db_proc99, file = here("input/data/proc/db_proc99.RData"))
```

```{r}
# ntile function without NAs
ntile_zero_na <- function(x, n = 10) {
  out   <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  is_na <- is.na(x)
  is0   <- !is_na & x == 0
  pos   <- !is_na & x > 0
  out[is0] <- 0
  if (any(pos)) out[pos] <- ntile(x[pos], n)
  out
}

db_proc09 <- db_proc09 %>% 
 mutate_at(vars(6:46), ~ as.numeric(.)) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(6:46), funs(car::recode(. ,"999990 = NA; 999997 = NA; 999998 = NA; 999999 = NA; 
                                              9999990 = NA; 9999997 = NA; 9999998 = NA; 9999999 = NA;
                                              99999990 = NA; 99999997 = NA; 99999998 = NA; 99999999 = NA"))) %>% 
  mutate(
    income_personal = do.call(coalesce, across(6:46)),
    income_decil    = ntile_zero_na(income_personal, 10)
  )

db_proc09 %>% 
  mutate(n_non_na = rowSums(!is.na(pick(6:46)))) %>% 
  count(n_non_na)
frq(db_proc09$income_decil)
```

```{r}
# ntile function without NAs
ntile_zero_na <- function(x, n = 10) {
  out   <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  is_na <- is.na(x)
  is0   <- !is_na & x == 0
  pos   <- !is_na & x > 0
  out[is0] <- 0
  if (any(pos)) out[pos] <- ntile(x[pos], n)
  out
}

db_proc19 <- db_proc19 %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(5:34), ~ as.numeric(.)) %>% 
 mutate_at(vars(5:34), funs(car::recode(. ,"-9 = NA; -8 = NA; -7 = NA; -2 = NA"))) %>% 
  mutate(
    income_personal = do.call(coalesce, across(5:34)),
    income_decil    = ntile_zero_na(income_personal, 10)
  )

db_proc19 %>% 
  mutate(n_non_na = rowSums(!is.na(pick(5:34)))) %>% 
  count(n_non_na)
frq(db_proc19$income_decil)
```

```{r}
db_proc19 <- db_proc19 %>%
  mutate(
    isco08 = set_na(isco08, na = c(-9,-8,-4), drop.levels = F),
    emprel = set_na(emprel, na = c(-9,-4), drop.levels = F),
    isco88_4 = isco08to88(isco08),
    selfemp_bin = if_else(emprel %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0),
    nemploy_rec = case_when(
      emprel == 2         ~ 0,   # self-employed sin empleados
      emprel %in% c(3,4)  ~ 1,   # self-employed con empleados
      TRUE                 ~ NA_real_
    ),
    egp5  = isco88toEGP(isco88_4, n.employees = nemploy_rec,
                         self.employed = selfemp_bin, n.classes = 5)
  )

frq(db_proc19$egp5)
```

# Descriptives

## Main variables per country and wave

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vars
#| tbl-cap: "Missing values percent per variable by country-wave"
#| tbl-cap-location: top
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

db_proc$wave <- as.factor(db_proc$year)
db_proc$country_wave <- do.call(paste, c(db_proc[c("iso_country", "wave")], sep = "_"))

tab <- db_proc %>%
  select(country_wave, just_health,  just_educ, ess, egp5, starts_with("merit"), starts_with("nmerit")) %>%
  group_by(country_wave) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),                     
      list(
        n_complete = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
        n_na       = ~sum(is.na(.)),
        n_total    = ~length(.),
        pct_na     = ~mean(is.na(.)) * 100
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  select(country_wave, ends_with("pct_na")) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, ~ round(.,2)) %>% 
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "_pct_na"))

num_cols <- setdiff(names(tab), "country_wave")

tab_fmt <- tab %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(num_cols),
    ~ ifelse(
      is.na(.x), "",  # opcional: celdas NA como vacío en la salida
      ifelse(
        .x == 100,
        kableExtra::cell_spec(sprintf("%.2f", .x), "html", color = "white", background = "darkred"),
        sprintf("%.2f", .x)
      )
    )
  ))

kableExtra::kable(tab_fmt,
                  format = "html",
                    booktabs= T, 
                    escape = F, 
                    align = 'c') %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive", full_width = FALSE))

```

## Class

```{r}
#| label: fig-egp-wave
#| fig-cap: "Class structure (EGP-5) by ISSP wave"
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

egp_labels <- c(
  "I-III      White-collar workers" = "White-collar (I-III)",
  "IV.a+IV.b  Petty bourgeoisie"    = "Petty bourgeoisie (IV.a-b)",
  "IV.c+VII.b Farm workers"         = "Farm workers (IV.c+VII.b)",
  "V+VI       Skilled workers"      = "Skilled workers (V-VI)",
  "VII.a      Non-skilled workers"  = "Non-skilled workers (VII.a)"
)

egp_colors <- c(
  "White-collar (I-III)"        = "#2a78d6",
  "Petty bourgeoisie (IV.a-b)"  = "#eb6834",
  "Farm workers (IV.c+VII.b)"   = "#1baf7a",
  "Skilled workers (V-VI)"      = "#eda100",
  "Non-skilled workers (VII.a)" = "#e87ba4"
)

tab_egp <- db_proc %>%
  filter(!is.na(egp5)) %>%
  mutate(egp5_lab = factor(egp_labels[as.character(egp5)], levels = egp_labels)) %>%
  count(year, egp5_lab, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(tab_egp, aes(x = egp5_lab, y = pct, fill = egp5_lab)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", pct)), hjust = -0.2, size = 3, color = "#0b0b0b") +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  facet_wrap(~ year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = egp_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(tab_egp$pct) * 1.2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% within wave", title = "Class structure (EGP-5) by ISSP wave") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e1e0d9"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#52514e"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#0b0b0b"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#0b0b0b", face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fcfcfb", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fcfcfb", color = NA)
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ess-wave

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10, limits = c(1, 11.3), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))) +
```
